TWO_SHIFT_4ON4OFF.name: 2 × 12 h — 4 on, 4 off
TWO_SHIFT_4ON4OFF.hint: Day and night shifts of 12 hours. Each crew works 4 days, has 4 off, works 4 nights and has 4 off (16-day cycle).

TWO_SHIFT_PANAMA_223.name: 2 × 12 h — Panama 2-2-3
TWO_SHIFT_PANAMA_223.hint: Day and night shifts of 12 hours on the 2-2-3 rhythm: two weeks of days, then two weeks of nights (28-day cycle).

THREE_SHIFT_CONTINENTAL.name: 3 × 8 h — continental
THREE_SHIFT_CONTINENTAL.hint: Morning, evening and night shifts of 8 hours: 2 mornings, 2 evenings, 2 nights, 2 days off (8-day cycle).

THREE_SHIFT_WEEKLY.name: 3 × 8 h — weekly rotation
THREE_SHIFT_WEEKLY.hint: Morning, evening and night shifts of 8 hours: a week of each, then a week off (28-day cycle).

rtc.title: Round-the-clock template
rtc.hint: Cover 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with four crews. The shifts, one rotation pattern per crew and, if you choose, the team assignments and coverage targets are created together.
rtc.codePrefixHint: Shifts become {{prefix}}-D, {{prefix}}-N… and the crew patterns {{prefix}}-A to {{prefix}}-D.
rtc.anchorDateHint: Day 1 of every crew's cycle. Team assignments start on this date.
rtc.crewTeamsHint: Optional: put existing teams on crews. Each team gets its crew's rotation from the start date.
rtc.crewTeamsUnique: Use each team for one crew only.
rtc.coverageHint: Sets the minimum head count for every new shift on the branch, every day of the week.
rtc.needsManage: You need permission to manage shifts to create a template.
rtc.previewHint: What each crew works, day by day from the start date. Every shift of every day must be covered.
rtc.fixForm: Complete the form to see the preview.
rtc.covered: Every shift is covered every day
rtc.applied: Created {{shifts}} shifts, {{patterns}} rotation patterns and {{assignments}} team assignments.
rtc.recalcHint: Attendance of the crews' past days is being recalculated.

coverage.targetsHint: The minimum number of people a branch — or a place in it, such as a site, floor or zone — needs on a shift, on the weekdays you choose.
coverage.dialogHint: Choose the branch and shift, the weekdays and the minimum head count.
coverage.locationHint: A site, floor or zone of the branch: only the people who work there count. Leave empty for the whole branch.
coverage.minHeadcountHint: People who must be scheduled on the shift.
coverage.deleteHint: The report will no longer show gaps for this shift on the branch.
coverage.emptyHint: Add a target to see where a branch is short of people.
coverage.reportHint: People scheduled against the targets, by day and shift — and by place for a target on a site, floor or zone: shift assignments, rotations and double shifts. Days off, holidays and approved leave are left out.
coverage.nothingScheduledHint: No targets and nobody scheduled at this branch in these days.

double.hint: A double shift adds a second fixed shift to an employee's day for a period. Both shifts are calculated as one day, with the time between them as an unpaid break.
double.dialogHint: The additional shift must be a fixed shift that does not overlap the employee's own shift and fits in less than 24 hours with it.
double.shiftHint: Only fixed shifts can be combined.
double.toHint: Leave empty for no end date.
double.noPrimary: No other shift that day: {{shift}} is the day's shift.

refusal.SAME_SHIFT: This is already the employee's shift that day.
refusal.NOT_FIXED: Only fixed shifts can be combined into one day.
refusal.TOO_LONG: Together the shifts span 24 hours or more.

double.recalcHint: Attendance of the affected past days is being recalculated.
double.emptyHint: Assign an additional shift to employees who work two shifts a day.
double.endHint: The additional shift stops after the last day you choose.
double.deleteHint: The days it covered are recalculated with the employee's own shift only.

deployments.title: Branch deployments
deployments.subtitle: Employees working at another branch for a while. They can check in at that branch and are on its terminals for those days; their attendance and payroll stay with their own branch.
deployments.dialogHint: The employee keeps their branch, calendar and payroll. A permanent move is a transfer on the employee's profile.
deployments.toHint: At most a year after the first day.
deployments.toBeforeFrom: The last day cannot be before the first day.
deployments.enrolHint: Added to the branch's terminals on the first day (at once if that is today) and removed after the last day. A night shift that starts on the last day can still check out there the next morning.
deployments.enrolQueued: Adding the employee to the terminals of {{branch}}.
deployments.enrolOnFirstDay: Deployment saved. The employee will be added to the terminals of {{branch}} on {{date}}.
deployments.cancelHint: Check-in at the branch stops and the employee is removed from the terminals this deployment added them to.
deployments.emptyHint: Deploy an employee when they work at another branch for a while.

banner.hint: You can check in at that branch as well as at your own.
